visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen view shows a man with short black hair sitting on a beige couch wearing a black patterned shirt, with text overlays about a breakup; a woman appears in a small oval frame at the top. (2) The woman becomes the main subject, sitting in an indoor room with a wooden bunk bed and a plush pillow; she has long black hair and is wearing a beige knit cardigan, speaking directly to the camera with a serious facial expression. (3) A brief, grainy clip of a small child being lifted into the air appears, followed by an infographic showing a list of physical injuries on a pink background. (4) Multiple photos and clips of a thin, small child with a blurred face are shown in different domestic settings; the child appears frail and in some scenes is wearing a mask or sitting on a play mat. (5) A detailed medical-style infographic displays a child's silhouette with red circles highlighting various abuse-related injuries including broken bones and burns. (6) A green plastic bucket is shown on a tiled floor, followed by a digital illustration of an older man in glasses forcefully placing a small child into that same green bucket inside a living room setting. (7) A screen recording of a mobile phone displays a news feed with various articles about child abuse and court cases, featuring the name 'Kaikai'. (8) The woman returns to the full frame, looking emotionally distressed and tearful as she continues to speak. (9) A sequence of black screens with bold white Chinese text appears, alternating with a red and white informative poster detailing a court date, time, and a call for a gathering. (10) The video ends with a final black screen and white text regarding zero tolerance for child abuse.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem Statement -> Emotional Engagement -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a social advocacy piece aimed at raising awareness and mobilizing public support for a specific child abuse case in Taiwan (the 'Kaikai' case). It uses a trending 'breakup' hook to pivot into a serious discussion of abuse, utilizing evidence-based infographics and emotional personal testimony from a mother's perspective to invite viewers to attend a court hearing.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges personal influencer content with social justice commentary. The use of split-screen and trending topics as a 'hook' is a tactical choice for algorithmic reach.
